observations.body: Manoah offers a young goat and grain on a rock; flame rises, the angel ascends in it, and Manoah and his wife interpret the encounter differently.
observations.label: Manoah’s offering rises with the angel

observations.body: The passage presents hospitality, offering, flame, angelic ascent, fear, and counter-reading as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: hospitality, offering, flame, angelic ascent, fear, and counter-reading

observations.body: The passage places wonder and interpretation beside hospitality, offering, flame, angelic ascent, fear, and counter-reading.
observations.label: wonder and interpretation

payload.posture: Read Judges 13:15–23 as evidence about sacrifice, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: the couple agrees on what happened but differs over whether they will die
